acceptance_criteria.given: a scratch Hub and a document whose FR-1 the operator words three times
acceptance_criteria.then: the detail lists created, reworded, reworded with the three wordings, operator as actor, ids equal to spec_requirement_revisions, the current statement and document, and a drift list

acceptance_criteria.given: a requirement reworded and then retired
acceptance_criteria.then: the rewording carries the new statement and the retirement carries null
the rows survive with a null statement and the column is gone after the downgrade
acceptance_criteria.when: it upgrades to 0131 and downgrades back

acceptance_criteria.then: every revision is listed with its actor, unrecorded wordings say so, and there is no console error
acceptance_criteria.when: the story of a reworded requirement is opened from its coverage row

design: D1 Record forward, never invent backward. Revisions before 0131 hold a digest only; the story says the wording was not recorded rather than guessing from git or the current file. D2 Extend the existing detail route rather than add one: it already answers tasks, evidence and coverage for a requirement, and one read per screen keeps one order. D3 The diff is between consecutive recorded wordings; a gap (unrecorded) breaks the chain and is shown as such. D4 Hazard and rollback: 0131 adds a nullable TEXT column; downgrade is a plain DROP COLUMN (a batch rebuild fails on early-revision databases, DEAD-ENDS 2026-10-17). :8000 is not restarted by this change.
problem: spec_requirement_revisions records that a requirement's meaning moved and who moved it, but only as digests: the wording it moved from cannot be recovered, and no route or screen reads the table at all. Drift, including resolved drift, is likewise invisible. Slice requirement-story of roadmap spdoc-d882f76795b3. Hazard: a migration (0131, one nullable column) that the operator's :8000 applies on its next restart.

requirements.rationale: A digest records that the meaning moved, not what it said.
requirements.statement: Every requirement revision recorded from migration 0131 on MUST store the statement the requirement had after the revision, or null for a retirement.

GET /spec/requirements/{identifier} MUST return the requirement's current statement and document, its revisions oldest first each with classification, actor, run, time and statement (null where it was not recorded), and every drift row with its state and resolution.

requirements.rationale: How a requirement changed is the question a drifted or superseded piece of evidence raises.
requirements.statement: The app MUST show a requirement's story, reachable from its coverage row and from its group in the evidence browser, with each recorded wording as a word diff from the previous one, who changed it and when, an explicit note where a wording was not recorded, and its tasks, evidence and drift.

requirements.rationale: The operator's :8000 applies it on restart.
requirements.statement: Migration 0131 MUST add only a nullable column, leave existing rows unchanged, and downgrade by dropping that column.

in_scope: Migration 0131: spec_requirement_revisions.statement, nullable; written on every new revision from the declared requirement
GET /spec/requirements/{identifier} gains the current statement, the document (path, title), revisions oldest first with their statement, and every drift row with its resolution

A requirement story view in the app, reachable from a coverage row and from an evidence group, showing each wording as a diff from the one before, who changed it, the tasks, the evidence and the drift
non_goals: Backfilling wording for revisions recorded before 0131: a digest cannot be turned back into words
Classifying a rewording as editorial or substantive

summary: Each revision of a requirement records the wording it introduced, and a requirement's detail answers its wording history with who changed it, its tasks, its evidence and all its drift, shown in the app from any requirement.

tasks.description: Migration 0131; spec_index records the statement; the detail route's revisions, drift, statement and document; RequirementStory in the Spec view (?view=requirement&focus=spreq-...), linked from the coverage row and the evidence browser; tests and the drive.
